# Anti-vacuous floor for the testcontainers-backed tier. The tier is detected at
# runtime: a pytest plugin records which test modules actually started a
# container, so a docstring mention cannot enrol a module and a container
# fixture defined in conftest cannot hide one.
#
# container_starts is the number unit-test growth cannot inflate: it counts
# containers, not tests. tier_passed is the broader signal and does include unit
# tests co-located in those modules - with Docker removed, 41 of them still pass,
# so the container-only margin is 393 - 41 = 352. Both numbers are recorded so a
# regenerated floor shows the margin moving in the diff instead of silently.
#
# Regenerate both together from the "container starts=... passed=..." line the
# tier-assertion step prints on a healthy run.
tier_passed 393
container_starts 23
